last_summary: v2 is the strongest egg-use case because of visible eggshells near the pale yellow batter, making options A and B less supported. v3 has the clearest visible non-egg batter preparation evidence: beer poured into flour and later fish dipped into the prepared batter, with no eggs in the cited local spans. v4 shows a liquid mixture with orange swirls and a separate dry mixture, but no visible egg cracking or addition in the cited span; the orange swirl remains ambiguous between egg and another ingredient. v1 also lacks visible eggs, but its liquid source is unresolved. Given the available choices, C is the best-supported option, though whole-video absence of eggs is not definitively proven.
